scope: Read-only review of engine/world/ui contracts plus lightweight Node probes; no browser and no production-file edits.

discoveredAndFixed.issue: v1 F5 old growth could coexist with the new contract-cache budget
discoveredAndFixed.reproductionBeforeFix: Old engine walked from floor-entry fixture to f4-11 without opening either door; old +3 attack plus new blue cache +5 yielded +8.
discoveredAndFixed.fixObserved: Actual old growth removal marks locksLegacy and closes the cache; contract routes remain selectable, and UI announces inheritance.

discoveredAndFixed.issue: v1 F11 old ruby could coexist with a new scroll reward
discoveredAndFixed.reproductionBeforeFix: Old ruby +5 and new attack scroll +4 yielded +9.
discoveredAndFixed.fixObserved: Old ruby removal inherits silk attack choice and records silkLegacy without adding stats.

discoveredAndFixed.issue: Old door opening alone must not suppress an unclaimed growth reward
discoveredAndFixed.fixObserved: Opening only inherits the chosen route; the cache remains available unless actual old growth was claimed.

Source review: two-tower and furnace conditions resolve saved real control IDs; getTile and migrate resolve water crossing from saved tides, relocating wall or submerged legacy coordinates to the floor altar.

boundaries: Legacy probes initialize a documented chapter-entry fixture and inherited seal/visited values; they are not a replay of the entire original v1 adventure. Claiming the legacy items and door opening use the actual backed-up v1 engine with walk, fight, consumable, and openDoor methods. Current-version final placement adjacent to a cache or scroll is a directed fixture, not a full campaign.
No new full-suite runs, browser sessions, screenshots, sound playback, mobile interaction, or human first-play study were performed by this reviewer.
Source review and directed probes did not reveal an additional mainline bypass or softlock; this is not an exhaustive proof over every resource allocation and historical save.
